notes.title: V104 Multi-language update!
notes.content:
- You can now change language via the options screen. Supported languages are: German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese.
Please note: at present we do not plan to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio and cannot afford to do so but we welcome fan translations if people want to do that.
- Deleted Character Stats Panel because it is not used in this game.
- Chapter cards now have dynamically drawn text so that they can be localised.
- Ability cards now have dynamically drawn labels so that they can be localised.
- Deleted ActiveAbilityBase and PassiveAbilityBase images.
- Tweaked long button label alignment to be more centered.
- Moved the English body text down for The Basics tutorial.
- Gold cards now have dynamically drawn labels so that they can be localised.

notes.title: V1.03 Update
notes.content:
Hi, just a small update with a few tweaks/fixes.

- Fixed a bug where if you finished a duel mid-Combo the multiplier readout would be incorrect when the enemy attacks you.
- Sped up UI fade out on Select Chapter screen when you choose a chapter.
- Prevented a double volume click from happening when you use an Active Ability card.
- Removed a hidden card from hand 19-4.
- Changed hard mode "You didn't get a perfect hand" warning to occur before the loot dialog shows.
- Steam Deck: Game no longer closes when opening a webpage if running in full screen mode.
- Steam Deck: Inventory now says "Tap icons for details" instead of "Mouse over icons"

notes.title: Update V1.02
notes.content:
Just a small bug fix and item prices update.

- Fixed bug on Hand 19-3 where picking up the gold crates didn't show gold+50 and didn't add to gold total. 
- Jeweled Scimitar sell price boosted to 200 gold.
- Clothing items gained via loot now also have sell prices. However, be aware that there's an achievement for owning all outfit items, so you might not want to sell them unless you plan to buy them back later at inflated prices.

notes.title: Update V1.01
notes.content:
Hi, this update contains 3 new checkboxes on the Options screen and a couple of other tweaks.

- Added checkbox to toggle card and UI tooltips to Options screen.
- Added checkbox to toggle animated glow on charged ability cards to Options screen.
- Added checkbox to toggle bold item card text to Options screen. This is enabled by default on Steam Deck.
- Added a tooltip for masquerede cards.
- The first story dialog now says "Tap" instead of "Click" on Steam Deck.
- Added current graphics driver label to corner of options screen.
- Moved wallpaper screen arrows down close to bottom of screen.
